premise: The wind blows Acorn's little cap off; Squirrel brings a petal, Raccoon brings a leaf, and Bird finds the real cap on a high branch; Acorn keeps all three as presents.
inspiration: Cinderella's slipper search (Perrault), turned into a hat hunt where every wrong fit is a gift.
lesson: Help that does not fit is still a gift.

en-US.title: Acorn Loses Her Cap
en-US.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} Acorn {acorn:pulse} had a little brown cap, and she loved it. Then the wind came. {sfx:wind} Whoosh! [surprised] {acorn:wobble x2} And the cap was gone. [sad] My cap! said Acorn. My head feels all… airy. Squirrel {squirrel:hop x2} ran up. I will find it! She came back with a petal. Try this! Acorn put it on. {acorn:tint #FFB6D9 1.5s} It was pink and floppy and much too big. [giggles] Acorn giggled. Raccoon {raccoon:hop} came with a leaf. Try this! Acorn put it on. {acorn:tint #B8E6A0 1.5s} It was green and crunchy and slid over one eye. [curious] Then Bird called down from up high. Is this it? And down he flew, a little brown cap in his beak. {bird:hop} {sfx:pop} Pop! On it went. Just right. Acorn {acorn:sparkle} looked at her petal, and her leaf, and her cap. [happily] I will keep all three, she said. One for sunny days, one for rainy days, and one for just being me.

es-ES.title: Bellota pierde su sombrero
es-ES.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} Bellota {acorn:pulse} tenía un sombrerito marrón, y le encantaba. Entonces llegó el viento. {sfx:wind} ¡Fiuuu! [surprised] {acorn:wobble x2} Y el sombrerito desapareció. [sad] ¡Mi sombrero!, dijo Bellota. Siento la cabeza como… ventilada. Ardilla {squirrel:hop x2} llegó corriendo. ¡Yo lo busco! Y volvió con un pétalo. ¡Prueba esto! Bellota se lo puso. {acorn:tint #FFB6D9 1.5s} Era rosa, blandito y muy grande. [giggles] Bellota se rio. Mapache {raccoon:hop} llegó con una hoja. ¡Prueba esto! Bellota se la puso. {acorn:tint #B8E6A0 1.5s} Era verde, crujiente y se le caía sobre un ojo. [curious] Entonces Pájaro gritó desde arriba. ¿Es este? Y bajó volando con un sombrerito marrón en el pico. {bird:hop} {sfx:pop} ¡Pop! Puesto. Justo a su medida. Bellota {acorn:sparkle} miró su pétalo, su hoja y su sombrero. [happily] Me quedo los tres, dijo. Uno para los días de sol, otro para los de lluvia y otro para ser yo.

wind.prompt: a sudden playful gust of wind, quick whoosh through leaves

pop.prompt: a small snug pop, like a tiny cap fitting neatly onto something round
